rem Four Representations using Squares
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=229
rem Count the n up to Limit that are
rem a^2 + b^2, a^2 + 2 b^2, a^2 + 3 b^2
rem and a^2 + 7 b^2 for positive a and b

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option Limit integer = 2000000000

rem With a and b allowed to be 0, n is
rem all four when n = q m^2, q
rem squarefree with every prime p = 1,
rem 25 or 121 mod 168. Those n number
rem the m up to sqrt(Limit / q) for each
rem such q, so the sum is over the
rem primes p, and the pairs and triples
rem of them, with the count of m with q
rem m^2 up to Limit being a count of the
rem primes up to Limit / (q' m^2) for
rem the last prime, found by binary
rem search on the sorted list of these
rem primes, sieved by classes mod 168.
rem Squares have b = 0 too often: q = 1
rem is dropped and the squares m^2 = a^2
rem + d b^2, with a, b above 0 for all
rem four d, are counted from the
rem divisors u v = d b^2 of m + a and m
rem - a, which are m = (u + v) / 2 up to
rem the root of Limit.
Rt = Limit isqrt
Pq = primes till (Rt + 1) array
Gp = array shape 0 fill 0
Rc = array 1 25 121
for R in Rc
  Kn = (Limit - R) // 168 + 1
  Sv = array shape Kn fill 0
  for Q in Pq
    if Q less 5 or Q equal 7
      continue
    end
    Iv = 1
    Bs = 168 mod Q
    Ex = Q - 2
    for
      if Ex equal 0
        break
      end
      if Ex mod 2 equal 1
        Iv = Iv * Bs mod Q
      end
      Bs = Bs * Bs mod Q
      Ex = Ex // 2
    end
    K0 = (Q - R mod Q) mod Q * Iv mod Q
    Ks = (Q * Q - R + 167) // 168
    if Ks less 0
      Ks = 0
    end
    Fk = Ks + (K0 - Ks) mod Q
    for K in Fk to (Kn - 1) by Q
      Sv K = 1
    end
  end
  Ix = 0 till Kn array
  Vals' = Ix * 168 + R
  Keep = Sv equal 0
  Pm' = Vals filter Keep
  Gp = concat Gp Pm copy
end
Gp = Gp filter (Gp greater 1) array
Gp = Gp sort
Ng = Gp len
Qx = array shape 100000 fill 0
Qs = array shape 100000 fill 0
Nq = 0
for M in 1 to Rt
  X = Limit // (M * M)
  if X less 193
    break
  end
  Qx Nq = X
  Nq += 1
end
for I in 0 till Ng
  P1 = Gp I
  if P1 * P1 greater Limit
    break
  end
  for M in 1 to Rt
    X = Limit // (P1 * M * M)
    if X at most P1
      break
    end
    Qx Nq = X
    Qs Nq = I + 1
    Nq += 1
  end
  for J in (I + 1) till Ng
    P2 = Gp J
    if P1 * P2 * P2 greater Limit
      break
    end
    for M in 1 to Rt
      X = Limit // (P1 * P2 * M * M)
      if X at most P2
        break
      end
      Qx Nq = X
      Qs Nq = J + 1
      Nq += 1
    end
  end
end
Total = 0
for Qi in 0 till Nq
  X = Qx Qi
  Lo = 0
  Hi = Ng
  for
    if Lo at least Hi
      break
    end
    Md = (Lo + Hi) // 2
    if Gp Md at most X
      Lo = Md + 1
    else
      Hi = Md
    end
  end
  Total += Lo - Qs Qi
end
Sp = array shape (Rt + 1) fill 0
for P in 2 to (Rt isqrt)
  if Sp P equal 0
    for J in (P * P) to Rt by P
      if Sp J equal 0
        Sp J = P
      end
    end
  end
end
W = Rt + 1
Tab = array shape (4 * W) fill 0
Ds = array 1 2 3 7
Pl = array shape 20 fill 0
El = array shape 20 fill 0
Dv = array shape 20000 fill 0
for Di in 0 to 3
  D = Ds Di
  for B in 1 to Rt
    Np = 0
    V = B
    for
      if V equal 1
        break
      end
      P = Sp V
      if P equal 0
        P = V
      end
      Ex = 0
      for
        if V mod P greater 0
          break
        end
        V = V // P
        Ex += 1
      end
      Pl Np = P
      El Np = 2 * Ex
      Np += 1
    end
    if D greater 1
      Fd = 0 - 1
      for I in 0 till Np
        if Pl I equal D
          Fd = I
        end
      end
      if Fd less 0
        Pl Np = D
        El Np = 1
        Np += 1
      else
        El Fd = El Fd + 1
      end
    end
    Dv 0 = 1
    Nd = 1
    for I in 0 till Np
      Old = Nd
      Pw = 1
      for E in 1 to (El I)
        Pw = Pw * Pl I
        for L in 0 till Old
          Dv Nd = Dv L * Pw
          Nd += 1
        end
      end
    end
    N = D * B * B
    for L in 0 till Nd
      U = Dv L
      if U * U less N
        Vv = N // U
        if (U + Vv) mod 2 equal 0
          Mm = (U + Vv) // 2
          if Mm at most Rt
            Tab (Di * W + Mm) = 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
T0 = Tab (0 till W)
T1 = Tab (W till (2 * W))
T2 = Tab ((2 * W) till (3 * W))
T3 = Tab ((3 * W) till (4 * W))
Sq = (T0 * T1 * T2 * T3) sum
Answer = Total + Sq
Answer print
